context.topic: Конвейер ИИ-агентов для команд разработки (роли, проверки, контракты) — инструменты и услуги внедрения

task.description: Research the product line: Конвейер ИИ-агентов для команд разработки (роли, проверки, контракты) — инструменты и услуги внедрения. Market, prices, competitors, buyers, trends 2025-2026, Kazakhstan/CIS vs global. Facts with opened links and dates only.
acceptance_criteria: every price/competitor/market-size fact has a link

result.summary: 70 source pages opened and cited (checked 2026-09-29); 6 more could not be opened (403/404) and are listed as not verified. Tools [world, vendor pages]: Claude Code Pro $20, Max from $100, Team premium seat $100-125, Enterprise $20/seat + API usage; average spend $150-250 per developer per month; Anthropic Code Review $15-25 per review. Cursor Teams $40/user, Copilot Business $19 / Enterprise $39, Devin Team $80 + $40/seat, Factory Teams $60 + $40/seat, Kiro $20-200, AI review tools CodeRabbit $24-72, Greptile $30, Qodo $30 base. Free MIT kits with the same idea (roles, reviewer agent, spec): BMAD 53.6k stars, Spec Kit 139.3k, Superpowers 292.6k, wshobson/agents 40.1k; Anthropic docs describe writer/reviewer, verification subagent and Stop-hook gates. Market (analyst estimates): $9.35B in 2026 growing to $29.96B by 2031 (Mordor); Claude Code run-rate over $2.5B (Feb 2026); Cursor ARR $3B (May 2026). Pain: Stack Overflow 2025 found 66% frustrated by 'almost right' output and 87% worried about agent accuracy; Faros found PR review time up 91%; Sonar found 96% do not fully trust AI code and 38% say it takes more review effort; CodeRabbit found 1.7x more issues in AI PRs; METR measured 19% slower in 2025, with weak evidence in 2026. Services: global $5K half-day workshop, $15-40K team enablement, $75-250K transformation, about $1K per person; Russia 180-600k RUB per workshop; Kazakhstan: vibe-coding course 98,000 KZT, AI chat-agent packages 0.5-3M KZT, Claude resold from 15,000 KZT/month; no KZ prices found for implementing agentic development in teams. KZ demand on hh.kz: 37 postings mention Claude Code (341 on hh.ru); Kazdream requires Claude Code/Codex/Cursor and 'не принимать AI-решения вслепую'; PanDev provides Claude Code Max x20; banks (ЦентрКредит, Halyk, Forte, Bereke, Home Credit) are hiring AI engineers. Claude is officially available in KZ/UZ/KG but not in RU/BY. Exchange rate 441.77 KZT/USD. Conclusions: the kit and review tools are commoditised; the paid part is implementation on the client's codebase and CI; a KZ pilot at 1-3M KZT is an assumption that needs buyer interviews.
